_estimator_note: plain corpus-grid means over the eval-default window grid; the DECISION-grade interval for any registry claim is the episode-cluster bootstrap (taniteval/ci.py) — run it before publishing

gate_a.rule: IoU(decode(z_hat_t+k)) >= 0.8 x IoU(decode(z_t+k encoded)) at k=10

mini_eval.tau_rule: argmax mean ENCODED-arm IoU pooled over ks (harder for the pred/enc retention gate, never easier)

visible_occluded_split.metric: cell recall vs subset raster (IoU vs a subset is confounded — the decoder legitimately predicts the complement subset's cells)

tier: T0-diagnostic (representation probe — NEVER a driving-performance number; one row of the WM-physics battery, not a standalone driving eval)
training_target: BCE on decode(z_t) vs GT raster at t — ENCODED latents only; predicted path eval-only by design
